empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.heading: Preview
preview.blurb: The skill body as the model receives it, rendered. Config holds the same text as Markdown source.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

config.heading: Configuration
config.nameHint: Lowercase and hyphenated, like a filename — it becomes the skill's heading in the assembled prompt.
config.descriptionHint: Say when an agent should apply this skill. This is the skill's interface — it is what an agent reads to decide the body is relevant.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Apply when reviewing a pull request that changes test files.
config.typeHint: Grouping only — it does not change what is sent to the model.
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Editing the body is the entire skill — everything else is metadata.
config.noteHint: Optional — one line, stored with the version this save snapshots.
config.notePlaceholder: Tightened scope rule; cap at 5 high-signal findings
config.saveHint: Saving snapshots the body as v{n}

danger.title: Delete skill
danger.body: Removes it from all agents. This can't be undone.
danger.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}:

versions.heading: Versions
versions.blurb: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.loadError: Could not load this skill's history.

empty.title: No history yet
empty.body: Saving a changed body snapshots it here as a new version.

create.title: Add a skill
create.subtitle: Write or paste the Markdown an agent should append to its prompt.
create.externalLabel: This came from a third party
create.externalHint: Tick it for anything you did not write yourself. The body is stored as untrusted data, delimiter-wrapped, and the skill stays disabled until you have vetted it.
create.footerNote: Saved as v1 · added to Skills Lab
